A medium pressure massage where they massage the acupressure points with oils  like rose, lavender, lemongrass and Tulsi, followed by the use of Potli with Tibetan music playing in the background. Absolutely recommend! 10/10!

featured_reviews.name: karishma deole
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have visited Sohum a few times over the past 2–3 years. It has always been on the expensive side, but I felt it was worth it because of the relaxing ambience—which is exactly what you expect from a spa. The therapists are skilled and the treatments are generally good.However, the service is consistently slow—despite appointments, there’s usually a 15+ minute wait (even longer for potli).
Recently, I took my mother there for her 60th birthday and politely asked if they offered anything special for occasions. They refused. I wasn’t expecting a major discount, but at least a small gesture would have been appreciated.
While paying the bill, I noticed that the prices have increased significantly, but there has been no improvement in the service, ambience, or overall experience to justify such a steep hike. I was also charged 18% GST instead of 5%. When I questioned this, the explanation provided was unclear and not very convincing.
Unfortunately won't be returning.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Ma'am, thank you for your frank review. We are sorry to hear that you were not 100% satisfied with your experience at Sohum. We try our best to meet guest expectations, but in some instances, like guests coming late or taking mush longer than usual to vacate the room after therapy, etc is beyond our control and this causes the best schedule to go haywire. As far as GST is concerned we can provide the explanation if you could connect with us.
We have taken note of your concerns and will improve on them wherever possible. We urge you to visit us again and promise not to disappoint.
